source: 644 Patrol Team
target: 644 Manipulus Custodum

source: Camus stood at the entrance of the Matani Import and Export Shop, casually smoking a cigarette as he observed the passing customers.
target: Camus ad ostium Tabernae Importationis et Exportationis Matani stetit, cigarette leniter fumans, dum clientes transeuntes observabat.

source: Despite his watchful eyes, he didn’t spot anyone purchasing Fermo coffee.
target: Attente oculis suis, neminem Fermo coffee emere animadvertit.

source: As the gas street lamps gradually illuminated the surroundings, casting a dark blue hue across the sky, Camus extinguished his cigarette and tossed it into a nearby trash can.
target: Cum lucernae viariae a gas paulatim circumiecta illustrabant, caelum colore nigro caeruleo tinctum exhibentes, Camus cigarette exstinxit et in urna purgamentorum proxima coniecit.

source: He then made his way back to the beige four‐story building that housed the patrol team.
target: Deinde rediit ad aedificium quattuor tabulorum, colore “beige” notatum, quod manipulum custodum continebat.

source: Originally planning to indulge in an Intis feast in a neighborhood frequented by foreigners to celebrate his unexpected windfall of 40,000 verl d’or, his plans were disrupted by Louis Berry.
target: Primum consilium habebat ut se in convivio Intis, in vicinitate a peregrinis frequentata, frueretur ad celebrandam inopinatam fortunam cum 40,000 verl d’or adeptam; sed consilia eius a Ludovico Berry turbata sunt.

source: By the time he returned, it was already late, and he couldn’t be bothered to wait for a top chef to prepare something special.
target: Cum rediret, iam sero erat, et noluit exspectare ut coquus optimus aliquid speciale praepararet.

source: Instead, he decided to return to the patrol team, pool money with his close teammates, and order takeout from a nearby restaurant.
target: Pro ea re, decrevit ad manipulum custodum redire, pecunias cum sodalibus intimis congregare, et ex popina proxima cibum ad portandum imperare.

source: After satisfying his hunger, he intended to relax at a bar or dance hall.
target: Postquam famem suam satiavit, intendebat in caupona aut in aula saltationis se relaxare.

source: While crossing the hall, Camus spotted a teammate with dark brown skin, thick lips, and a height exceeding 1.8 meters.
target: Dum per aulam transibat, Camus sodalem animadvertit, cuius cutis fusca et brunea erat, labia crassa, et altitudo plus quam 1.8 metra ferebat.

source: Curious, he inquired, “Why did the guy in the straw hat come looking for you again?
target: Curiosus, interrogavit: “Cur ille vir pileo stramineo ornato te rursus quaerevenit?”

source: “Heh, I heard you and the others caught a Serial Killer and got a bounty of 50,000 verl d’or?”
target: “Heh, audivi te et ceteros interfectorem seriem cepisse et praemium 50,000 verl d’or adeptos esse?”

source: In Matani, the currency was commonly denoted in verl d’or and Delexi copper coins, a system ingrained during Intis colonization.
target: In Matani, moneta vulgo exprimebatur in verl d’or et nummis aereis Delexi, ratio quae per colonizationem Intis insita fuit.

source: Despite Admiral Querarill’s control, there were no significant changes in this aspect.
target: Non obstante potestate Admiralium Querarill, in hoc non erant mutationes notabiles.

source: The only difference was a partnership with the Feynapotter Kingdom’s bank that facilitated the free exchange of verl d’or and gold risot.
target: Unica differentia erat societas cum argentaria Regni Feynapotter, quae commutationem liberam verl d’or et aurum risot facilitavit.

source: If he were one of the two teammates–either the Magician or the Zombie–whom Louis Berry had asked about, Camus would undoubtedly be on high alert.
target: Si ex duobus sodalibus esset—aut Magus aut Zombie—de quibus Ludovicus Berry quaeserat, Camus indubitanter sollicitus foret.

source: However, the person standing in front of him was Sow, a Sequence 8 Pugilist of the Warrior pathway.
target: At vero, persona coram eo stans erat Sow, Pugilista Sequentiae 8 ex via Bellatoris.

source: Sow had joined the patrol team as an adventurer just last year and was known for having a pleasant personality.
target: Sow anno praeterito modo ad manipulum custodum ut adventor se adiunxit, et ob gratiam indolem nota erat.

source: Besides a bit of laziness and a love for enjoyment, there were no significant issues.
target: Praeter modicam ignaviam et amorem voluptatis, nullae difficultates notabiles erant.

source: Camus laughed and said, “That’s my informant. Without him, I wouldn’t have received that much bounty.”
target: Camus risit et dixit: “Hic est meus informator. Absque eo tantum praemium non adeptus essem.”

source: Sow, with his single eyelids, had a realization.
target: Sow, cum unico palpebro suo, aliquod animadvertit.

source: “Did he come to you just now to get his share?”
target: “Num modo ad te venit ut suam portionem acciperet?”

source: Camus thought for a moment and replied, “That’s one reason.
target: Camus paulisper cogitavit et respondit: “Hoc est unum ex motivis.

source: The other reason is that he’s still investigating the serial murders from four years ago and wanted to ask me for some details.”
target: Alterum autem est quod interficationes serias quadriennis abhinc adhuc indagat et mihi quaedam singula rogare voluit.”

source: He had kept the case dossier hidden from the captain and vice-captains of the patrol team, but he couldn’t keep it from his teammates.
target: Tabellam casus ab duce et subducibus manipuli custodum occultatam servaverat, sed ab sodalibus suis eam celare non potuit.

source: Therefore, he had no intention of concealing Louis Berry’s investigation into the serial murders from four years ago.
target: Ergo nullam intendebat investigationem Ludovici Berry de interficationibus seriis quadriennis abhinc celare.

source: Moreover, he planned to monitor the police headquarters to identify anyone who enjoyed Fermo coffee and seemed suspicious.
target: Praeterea, consilium erat praesidium vigilum observare ut quis Fermo coffee delectaretur et suspectus appareret.

source: He would need his teammates’ assistance to some extent.
target: Auxilium sodalium suorum ad aliquem gradum opus esset.

source: “Any progress? Any chance of claiming the bounty?”
target: “Quae progressio? Ulla occasio praemium accipiendi?”

source: Sow, dressed in a pleated shirt and carrying a broadsword, displayed visible interest.
target: Sow, indutus camisā plicatā et gladium latum ferens, conspicuum studium ostendit.

source: Camus wasn’t ready to provide detailed information at the moment.
target: Camus non paratus erat nunc informationes accuratas praebere.

source: He vaguely responded, “He suspects that the murderer might be hiding at the police headquarters from four years ago.
target: Vage respondit: “Suspicitur homicida fortasse in praesidio vigilum quadriennis abhinc latere.

source: I plan to investigate discreetly.”
target: Cautiter investigare intendo.”

source: “Why do you think the murderer is a police officer?”
target: “Cur putas homicidam esse vigilis virum?”

source: Sow looked puzzled.
target: Sow, perplexus, videbatur.

source: Camus hadn’t discussed this with Lumian earlier, so he pondered for a moment and explained, “Consider this.
target: Camus hoc antea cum Lumiano non tractaverat, itaque paulisper meditatus est et explicavit: “Considera hoc.

source: In the case four years ago, only Beyonders were targeted.
target: In casu quadriennio abhinc, solum Beyonders destinabantur.

source: Several of them usually concealed their identities.
target: Plurimi eorum identitates suas plerumque celabant.

source: How could the murderer accurately locate them and know that they were Beyonders?
target: Quomodo homicida eos precise localizare et scire posset eos Beyonders esse?

source: Only us or those from the police headquarters at a certain rank can access that kind of information.
target: Solum nos aut illos ex praesidio vigilum in certo gradu talem informationem accedere possunt.

source: It’s easier to verify if there are Beyonders of the Devil pathway on the patrol team.
target: Facilius est comprobari, si Beyonders viae Diaboli in manipulo custodum adsint.

source: Four years ago, during their investigation, Vice-Captain Reaza had proposed this idea.
target: Quadriennio abhinc, inter investigationem, Vice-Dux Reaza hanc ideam proposuerat.

source: However, he only suspected that the Serial Killer was hiding within the patrol team and hadn’t considered the police headquarters or the Admiral Guard.
target: Attamen, solum suspicabatur interfectorem seriem intra manipulum custodum latere et praesidium vigilum aut Custodiam Admiralii non consideraverat.

source: Subsequently, the patrol team conducted an investigation and found no suspicious individuals, leading them to shift their focus.
target: Postea, manipulus custodum perquisitionem perduxit et nullos individuos suspectos invenit, ita ut attentionem transferre coeperent.

source: “I see a glimmer of hope and smell the fragrance of verl d’or,” Sow said with anticipation.
target: “Speciem spei intueor et odorem verl d’or sentio,” inquit Sow cum exspectatione.

source: “If you need help, feel free to look for me. I heard that Kolobo and the others just followed you to the scene and each got 5,000 verl d’or!”
target: “Si auxilio opus est, libere me quaere. Audivi Kolobo atque alios te modo ad locum secuti esse et singuli 5,000 verl d’or adeptos esse!”

source: “No problem,” Camus readily agreed.
target: “Nulla quaestio,” Camus statim consentivit.

source: Then, he walked past Sow and along the corridor toward his office.
target: Tum, transiit praeter Sow et per corridor ad officium suum processit.

source: At the door of his office, Kolobo poked his head out, observing the conversation between Camus and Sow.
target: Ad ostium officii sui, Kolobo caput protraxit, colloquium inter Camus et Sow observans.

source: Kolobo, about the same age as Camus, in his mid-twenties, had dark hair, azure eyes, and a slender figure.
target: Kolobo, circiter eandem aetatem ac Camus habens, in mediis annis viginti natus, comam atram, oculos caeruleos, et corpus tenue habebat.

source: He held a pair of black sunglasses in his hand.
target: Par oculorum solariorum nigrorum in manu tenebat.

source: He lowered his voice and said to Camus, “Stay away from Sow for the time being.”
target: Vox suam demisit et Camus dixit: “A Sow ad tempus abstine.”

source: “Why?” Camus asked, surprised.
target: “Cur?” interrogavit Camus, miratus.

source: Observing Sow vanish through the door leading to the hall, Kolobo averted his gaze and explained,
target: Videns Sow per ostium ad aulam evanescere, Kolobo oculos avertit et explicavit:

source: “I have a feeling that something bad will happen if one interacts with him during this period.”
target: “Sentio aliquid mali futurum esse, si quis cum illo interagere conetur.”

source: “Then why didn’t you warn him?” Camus frowned in confusion.
target: “Quare ergo non eum monuisti?” Camus, frontem contrahens, interrogavit.

source: As a Sequence 8 Robot of the Monster pathway, Kolobo possessed formidable spiritual perception and could vaguely sense certain things.
target: Ut Robotus Sequentiae 8 ex via Monstrorum, Kolobo perceptionem spiritualem formidabilem habebat et quaedam vage sentire patebat.

source: “I warned him. He thinks everything’s fine. I even reported it to the Captain.” Kolobo shrugged.
target: “Eum monui. Existimat omnia esse in ordine. Etiam id Capitano renuntiavi,” dixit Kolobo, umeros levans.

source: As he spoke, the thin Beyonder recalled something.
target: Dum loquebatur, tenuis Beyonder rem aliquam meminit.

source: “That adventurer, Louis Berry, is also dangerous.
target: “Ille adventor, Ludovicus Berry, quoque periculosus est.

source: When I arrived at the scene this morning, I didn’t dare to look directly at him.
target: Cum hac mane ad locum perveni, non ausus sum directe in eum spectare.

source: Occasionally, I would glance at him and see large amounts of blood, flames, and death.
target: Interdum eum intuebar, et ingentes copias sanguinis, flammarum, et mortis observabam.

source: “I didn’t want to tell you at first.
target: “Primum nollebam tibi dicere.

source: I felt that if I said it, fate would suffocate me.
target: Sentiebam quod, si id dicerem, fata me suffocerent.

source: Phew, it actually seems okay to say it now.
target: Pheu, nunc re vera videtur id dicere licere.

source: It seems I’m too sensitive.”
target: Videtur me nimis sensibile esse.”

source: That dangerous? As expected of a great adventurer who received a bounty of 600,000 verl d’or at once…
target: Ille periculosus? Ut exspectabatur ab magno adventore, qui simul praemium 600,000 verl d’or accepit…

source: While Camus, who knew about Louis Berry’s deeds, wasn’t overly shocked, this was the first time he had heard a Monster like Kolobo describe someone in such a way.
target: Quamquam Camus, qui de factis Ludovici Berry sciebat, non nimis stupuit, hoc primum erat quod audivit monstrum ut Kolobo aliquem ita describere.

source: Camus patted Kolobo’s shoulder.
target: Camus humerum Kolobo pulsavit.

source: “Thank you. I’ll be careful.”
target: “Gratias. Cavebo.”

source: With that settled, he asked curiously, “Was Louis Berry the first person to give you such a feeling?”
target: Ita constitutum, curiosus rogavit: “Fuitne Ludovicus Berry primus qui tibi talem sensum dedit?”

source: “No, there’s another one.”
target: “Minime, alius est.”

source: Kolobo shook his head.
target: Kolobo caput movit.

source: “Who is it?” Camus was surprised.
target: “Quis est?” Camus miratus est.

source: Kolobo’s expression suddenly turned serious.
target: Vultus Kolobo subito serio factus est.

source: “I can’t say. I’ll die if I say it. I’ll die!”
target: “Non possum dicere. Moriar, si dixerim. Moriar!”

source: With that, the thin Beyonder swiftly left Camus’s office.
target: Itaque, tenuis Beyonder celeriter officium Camus reliquit.

source: Upon returning to Hotel Orella, Lumian headed straight for the master bedroom.
target: Rediens ad Hotel Orella, Lumian directe ad cubiculum principale se contulit.

source: In the subterranean suite, even during the scorching season, a refreshing coolness lingered in the air.
target: In suite subterranea, etiam tempore aestate ardenti, refrigerans frigiditas in aere manebat.

source: On the desk in the master bedroom, a neatly folded letter awaited Lumian.
target: In mensa cubiculi principalis, epistula diligenter plicata Lumiano exspectabat.

source: Madam Magician’s response… Lumian picked up the letter and began reading.
target: Responsum Dominae Magicae… Lumian epistulam sustulit et legere coepit.

source: “Excellent. You have a good understanding of yourself.
target: “Optime. Bene te intellegis.

source: “The Rose School of Thought and the Numinous Episcopate will be managed by dedicated personnel.
target: “Schola Rosi consilii et Episcopatus Numinous a personalibus dedicatis administrabuntur.

source: No need for you to take unnecessary risks.
target: Non opus est tibi pericula supervacua capere.

source: Concentrate on dealing with Hisoka.
target: Concentra te in rebus Hisoka tractandis.

source: If they request your help, you may cooperate.
target: Si auxilium tuum petant, cooperari poteris.

source: “The Beyonder characteristics left behind by members of the Rose School of Thought, especially those of the Devil and Prisoner pathways, come with a certain level of troublesome corruption.
target: “Characteres Beyonder ab membris Scholae Rosi relicti, praesertim eorum viae Diaboli et viae Carcerarii, cum aliquo gradu corruptionis molestae veniunt.

source: It’s advisable not to sell them or randomly seek out an Artisan to craft items.
target: Suadetur eos non vendere aut artificem temere quaerere ad res conficiendas.

source: If you need to, you can sell them to me or let me find an Artisan.
target: Si opus est, eos mihi vendere potes aut me artificem invenire sinere.

source: Keeping them in the Traveler’s Bag is also fine.
target: Eos in sacculo Itineris servare quoque satis est.

source: Compared to the Shadow Branch boxing gloves, Mr. Fool’s seal, and the attention and influence of other items on you, they’re as weak as an ordinary newborn baby.”
target: Comparatis cum manubriis pugilisticis Rami Umbrae, sigillo Domini Stulti, et cum attentione atque potentia aliorum rerum in te, tam infirmi sunt quam infans ordinarius recenter natus.

source: Relieved by this response, Lumian took a breath and activated the black mark on his right shoulder, vanishing from the room.
target: Liberatus hac responsione, Lumian spiritum cepit et notam atram in humero dextro suo activavit, ex conclavi evanescens.

source: After a while, he materialized atop a bell tower on Avenue du Boulevard in Trier.
target: Post aliquod tempus, in turrim campanariam in Avenue du Boulevard, Trier, apparuit.

source: Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Directe auctores in WebNovel sustine!

source: Gazing at the luxurious Champs-Élysées in the distance and the already lit lamps, Lumian couldn’t hold back any longer.
target: Spectans Champs-Élysées opulenta in longe et iam luminaria accensa, Lumian amplius se continere non potuit.

source: He needed to carefully consider the information he had just obtained from Camus.
target: Ipsam necesse habebat diligenter considerare informationes quas modo ab Camus acceperat.

source: With the Berserk Sea, the Feynapotter Kingdom, and half of the Intis Republic between them, Lumian could devise a plan to hunt Hisoka without worrying about the enemy sensing malice and danger!
target: Cum Mare Furiosum, Regnum Feynapotter, et dimidium Reipublicae Intis inter se essent, Lumian consilium capere poterat ut Hisoka venaret, sine metu hostium malevolentiae atque periculi sentiendi!

source: Perhaps only an Angel could sense over such a distance.
target: Forsitan solum Angelus tale spatium percipere posset.

source: Though Lumian lacked specific information about his target or Hisoka’s identity and had no concrete plan, caution was paramount when he had the ability to be cautious.
target: Quamquam Lumian informationes specificas de proposito suo aut de identitate Hisoka caruit, et consilium certum non obtinebat, cautela praecipua erat.

source: Relying on his Ascetic trait, he endured, putting aside thoughts of the corresponding matters.
target: Innixus indole ascetica, sustinuit, cogitationes rerum pertinentium deponens.

source: Only when far from Port Pylos and the Southern Continent did he carefully consider details, allowing his thoughts to run free.
target: Solum cum longe a Portu Pylos et Continente Meridionali erat, singulariter subtilia examinabat, cogitationibus suis libere fluere concedens.

source: After an indeterminate amount of time, Lumian vanished from the bell tower.
target: Post tempus indeterminatum, Lumian ex turrim campanariam evanuit.

source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

source: The pendulum clock struck 7 p.m.
target: Horologium pendulum septimam horam vespertinam sonavit.

source: The next morning.
target: Postridie mane.

source: Upon entering the hall, Camus spotted Louis Berry, adorned in a golden straw hat, seated on a sofa in the reception area.
target: In aulam ingrediens, Camus Ludovicum Berry, pileum stramineum aureum gerens, in solio in area receptionis sedere vidit.

source: Why is he here again?
target: Cur hic iterum adest?

source: Recalling Kolobo’s warning, Camus frowned and approached with concern.
target: Meminens monitionis Kolobo, Camus frontem contrahens et sollicite accessit.

source: “What can I do for you this time?” he asked calmly, keeping his emotions in check.
target: “Quid tibi hoc tempore facere possum?” interrogavit quiete, affectus suos temperans.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “I need some information, but it won’t be from you.
target: “Informationem aliquam mihi opus est, sed non a te.

source: Find a reliable teammate who isn’t privy to our discussion yesterday evening.
target: Reperi sodalem fidum, qui colloquio nostro hesterno vesperi non conscius sit.

source: Meet me at the Matani Import and Export Shop.
target: Conveni mecum ad Tabernam Matani Importationis et Exportationis.

source: “I can offer 5,000 verl d’or for this.”
target: “Hinc possum offerre 5,000 verl d’or.”

source: A peculiar request… 5,000 verl d’or. How generous…
target: Petitum insolitum… 5,000 verl d’or. Quam liberalis…

source: Is he trying to avoid a Devil’s danger premonition?
target: Num conatur vitare praenotitionem periculi Diaboli?

source: Camus, an experienced official Beyonder, quickly made the connection.
target: Camus, Beyonder peritus et officialis, celeriter intellexit.

source: He refrained from overthinking and pondered for a moment before responding, “Agreed.”
target: Non nimis cogitavit et paulisper meditatus est antequam responderet: “Assentior.”

source: Heading into the office area, Lumian rose and departed, making his way to the Matani Import and Export Shop nearby.
target: Ad spatium officii accedens, Lumian surrexit et discessit, iter faciens ad Tabernam Matani Importationis et Exportationis prope.

source: Soon, a man sat opposite Lumian, who was savoring his coffee.
target: Mox, vir adversus Lumian sedebat, qui suum coffee degustabat.

source: The man, with dark hair and a relatively thin build, was a member of the patrol team who had accompanied them to the scene yesterday.
target: Vir, capillis atris et corpore relativamente tenue, erat sodalis manipuli custodum qui heri eos ad locum comitatus fuerat.

source: Today, he wore dark-black sunglasses, giving him the appearance of a blind individual.
target: Hodie, oculos solares nigrissimorum gerebat, qui ei speciem caeci exhibebat.

source: “I’m Kolobo. Camus mentioned a chance to earn 5,000 verl d’or,” the patrol team member introduced himself in fluent Intisian.
target: “Ego sum Kolobo. Camus de occasione 5,000 verl d’or lucrandi dixit,” sodalis manipuli custodum se fluenter in Intisiano contulit.

source: Amused, Lumian observed Kolobo’s demeanor.
target: Divertitus, Lumian indolem Kolobo observavit.

source: Taking out a pen and paper, he counted out 5,000 verl d’or notes and slid them over.
target: Calamo et charta extrahens, 5,000 verl d’or notas enumeravit et tradidit.

source: “Write down the Prisoner pathway Beyonder’s name and details from the patrol team.
target: “Scribe nomen et singula Beyonder viae Carcerarii ex manipulo custodum.

source: Ensure I don’t catch sight of it.
target: Fac ut illud mihi non conspiciatur.

source: Fold it into a square after writing.”
target: Post scriptionem, plica illud in quadratum.

source: Kolobo, almost as if blind, fumbled for the banknotes.
target: Kolobo, quasi caecus, notas monetarias torpiter quaesivit.

source: He bent down and counted, nearly burying his head under the table.
target: Se inclinavit et numeravit, paene caput sub mensa abscondens.

source: “Why aren’t you looking at me?” Lumian asked with curiosity.
target: “Cur non in me spectas?” interrogavit Lumian cum curiositate.

source: Trembling, Kolobo replied, “I fear I might truly go blind.”
target: Trementes, Kolobo respondit: “Timeo me vere caecum fieri posse.”

source: Are you able to see something you shouldn’t? From the Monster pathway?
target: Licetne tibi aliquid videre quod videre non debes? Ex via Monstrorum?

source: Lumian pondered but refrained from probing further.
target: Lumian meditatus est, sed ulteriora indagare non ausus est.

source: Kolobo turned around and swiftly wrote down the corresponding information on the table behind him, folding the paper and passing it to Lumian.
target: Kolobo se convertit et celeriter informationem correspondentem in mensa retro scripsit, chartam plicans et Lumiano tradens.

source: Without a second glance, Lumian promptly received the information and stowed it in his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ne secundo intuitus, Lumian celeriter informationem accepit et in sacculo Itineris deposuit.

source: After settling the bill for his coffee, he headed to the washroom.
target: Postquam libellum pro coffee solvit, ad latrinam processit.

source: His figure vanished once more.
target: Figura eius iterum evanuit.
